title: An order-theoretic characterization of C*-algebras
summary: We give an order-theoretic characterization of the essential image of the forgetful functor from the category of real/complex unital C*-algebras to the category of real/complex unital operator systems. It is based on the characterization of JB-algebras among the order unit spaces in terms of the existence of gauge-reversing bijections obtained by M. Roelands and the author in arXiv:2507.09526. To this end, we show that a unital operator system is completely order isomorphic to a C*-algebra if and only if each of its matrix spaces admits a compatible JB-algebra structure.
